title: Plato's cave: someone outside the cave pulling us through

tellings.quote: like it would seem there has to be somebody outside of the cave doing this. Like there has somebody has to from the perspective of enlightenment be pulling us through.

plain: In The Republic, the ancient Greek philosopher Plato has his teacher Socrates describe prisoners in a cave who see only shadows on a wall until one is freed and led out into the light. On a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, a guest named James Madden says that, read closely, the story seems to need somebody outside the cave doing the freeing, someone pulling us through toward enlightenment. He raises it to suggest that human understanding may be guided by an intelligence beyond our own.
